name: Tim Wyatt
biography: is a software engineer whose 16-year career has focused on development of security products and products with critical security requirements. Most recently, this has led him to focus on security in the mobile space at Lookout Mobile Security. Prior to Lookout, Tim was a lead engineer for the Symantec (formerly Vontu) Network Data Loss Prevention Suite
